activity_summary: You said the line once, by the one candle. The three sheets were still on the board. You did not add to them, and you did not open the street door again.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the line once and did not write on the sheets.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in A door, if enough push

facets.activity: Said a door opens if enough push

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: They've found out a door opens if enough push. That's not a thing a city forgets.
